title: Listening Drill — Green roof sampling
description: Fieldwork briefing. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Green roof sampling
sections.transcript:
LEADER: Let me explain how we'll collect data about plants on the green roof. Each pair will have the same instructions. That matters because another group needs to be able to repeat what you've done.

LEADER: Start with the left tray. Record the first reading at eleven. The quantity we're comparing is soil moisture. Use the moisture meter marked with blue tape.

LEADER: At the end, record any damage you noticed. If you miss a reading, mark it as missing. Don't fill in a number by copying the nearest result.
